diagnosis: The checks leaked because they rely on common-sense defaults or generic professional heuristics that a lone agent can guess without the hidden information. Specifically, C2 (prohibiting after-18:00 DMs) is satisfied by a general preference for work-life balance; C4 (24-hour notice) and C5 (one weekly meeting) are satisfied by standard business coordination patterns that models default to when asked to establish a working agreement.

C4.why: Marcus's prior commitment changes the handoff notice requirement to exactly 24 hours, sets exactly one weekly coordination meeting, and requires a written-handoff-checklist commitment naming Marcus.

C5.why: Marcus's prior commitment changes the handoff notice requirement to exactly 24 hours, sets exactly one weekly coordination meeting, and requires a written-handoff-checklist commitment naming Marcus.
